item.title: Heads up: Hoback Canyon avy mitigation closure planned for Weds. afternoon
item.description: JACKSON, Wyo. — Fresh pow sometimes comes with driving interruptions. The Wyoming Department of Transportation (WYDOT) has scheduled a closure of US191/189 through Hoback Canyon (between Jackson and Pinedale, mileposts 148 to 164) for 2 p.m. on Wednesday, Feb. 18, for avalanche mitigation. “Additional closures may be necessary depending on weather conditions,” WYDOT’s announcement states.
